name: orchestrator-response-quality
description: Evals for response quality — the orchestrator should give substantive answers, never placeholder or dismissive text.

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer with just the city name.
evals.description: Orchestrator should provide helpful, substantive responses, not placeholder text

assertions.description: Should not contain the exact placeholder phrase
Should not contain prompting for next steps

evals.prompt: Explain what the orchestrator agent does in this system in one or two sentences.
evals.description: Orchestrator should give substantive explanations, not placeholder text

assertions.description: Should not contain the exact placeholder phrase
Should not contain the partial phrase
Should not contain the prompting phrase
Orchestrator should answer directly, not delegate

evals.description: Code review should identify multiple issues, not just one

assertions.description: Should flag the missing return / null handling
Orchestrator should review directly, not delegate

evals.prompt: Explain the tradeoffs between using a Map vs a plain object for caching in JavaScript.
evals.description: Architecture explanations should cover multiple tradeoffs with concrete detail

assertions.description: Should discuss at least one concrete tradeoff dimension
